description: CMIP5 drought projections in Canada based on the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Drought projections on seasonal to annual time scales are presented for Canada over the twenty-first century, based on the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI). Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Sécheresse, Changement climatique, Climat, Climatologie, météorologie. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, NETCDF, PDF. The portal shows 2022-10-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
